content: When a source transport protocol module requests the PDU Router module to copy the received data using PduR_<User:LoTp>CopyRx- Data , the PDU Router module shall forward the request to the destination upper layer module by calling <Up>_CopyRxData .

When a source Transport Protocol module requests the PDU Router module to copy the received data using PduR_<User:LoTp>CopyRx- Data , the PDU Router module shall forward the request to the upper layer destination module by calling <Up>_CopyRxData .
